capabilities: Recognize Bible references, including Korean book abbreviations
Insert chosen translations as plain text, quote or callout
Add verse numbers and source credit lines
extras: Ships no Bible text: users must place per-book JSON files in the vault (default folder 성경본문/<translation>/<NN><book>.json) and register each translation in settings. Free for personal, church and non-profit use; source is viewable but not open-source. All processing is local; no network access and no AI.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to resolve a Bible reference at the cursor and compare several translations side by side before inserting them into a note.
summary: Offline Bible reference lookup that compares translations side by side and inserts chosen ones into the note.
